description.fun: Miltank's milk is sweet and so nutritious that it's used to nurse sick Pokémon and people back to health, and it changes taste with the season and the quality of the pasture. A Miltank can give over five gallons a day, and it has supported people and Pokémon since ancient times. It's the counterpart of Tauros: Miltank are always female, Tauros always male.
description.guide: A Normal-type cow Pokémon that is always female, known for its sweet, nutritious milk, which can heal Pokémon and people. It is the counterpart of the all-male Tauros. It does not evolve.
description.tagline: The dairy cow of Pokémon, with famously healing milk
